comment: getVoltageSum() sums every channel of a polyphonic cable into one analysis lane, so the module reads polyphony but does not display it channel by channel. There are no outputs at all. The gain parameters run 0 to 3.981 with a display base of -10 and a multiplier of 20, which is how the tooltip reads -inf dB to 12dB. The ten parameters along the bottom of the display and the four input gains all have positions, so all fifteen controls can be clicked for help; index order matches panel order left to right. Every parameter has randomizeEnabled set false (src/SpectrumAnalyzer.cpp:183-184). The maker's manual is written against version 2.0.1 and matches this build's controls.
